Issue #3: WikiLinks: support a display label with `[[Target|Label]]` The `wikilinks` extension always uses the page name as the link text, so `[[Getting Started]]` becomes a link that says "Getting Started". Most wikis (MediaWiki, Obsidian, GitHub wikis) let you write `[[Page name|text to show]]` to link to a page with different text, and our content team keeps writing that out of habit. Right now it isn't recognized at all and the brackets show up in the output. What I'd like: - `[[Getting Started|read the guide]]` links to the same URL as `[[Getting Started]]` but shows "read the guide". - Whitespace around the `|` shouldn't matter (`[[Getting Started | read the guide]]` is the same thing). - Everything else (`base_url`, `end_url`, `html_class`, a custom `build_url`) should behave exactly like it does for normal wikilinks; only the visible text changes. - `[[Page]]` without a pipe keeps working as today. input.summary: The regex now matches `[[Target|Label]]` and the label is shown as link text. But the PR builds the URL from the label, not the target. `[[Getting Started|read the guide]]` links to `/read_the_guide/` when it should link to `/Getting_Started/`. That breaks the issue's main requirement: same URL as `[[Getting Started]]`, only the visible text changes. A custom `build_url` also receives the label instead of the target. The PR's tests only check the visible text, so they don't catch this.

findings.title: The URL is built from the display label instead of the target page
findings.evidence: `label = (m.group(2) or m.group(1)).strip()` is then passed to `self.config['build_url'](label, base_url, end_url)`. Running markdown.markdown('[[Getting Started|read the guide]]', extensions=['wikilinks']) gives href="/read_the_guide/" but should give "/Getting_Started/". The target (group 1) has to go to build_url, and only a.text should use group 2.

findings.title: The tests never check href, so they miss the wrong URL

', and also cover base_url/end_url/html_class/build_url with a label.

notes: docs/extensions/wikilinks.md is not updated to describe the new `[[Target|Label]]` syntax. This is worth adding but does not block the PR.
The label character class `[\w0-9_ -]` is narrow: labels with punctuation such as `[[Page|Read this!]]` won't match. This does not block the PR, but consider allowing a wider label set.
